title: Vaporwave Text Generator
description: Convert text to full-width ＶＡＰＯＲＷＡＶＥ style — the wide aesthetic lettering for bios, captions and titles.
howto: It converts instantly to full-width Unicode characters (ＡＢＣ １２３).
Copy the result and paste it into bios, captions or video titles.

faqs.a: Unicode "fullwidth" forms (U+FF01–U+FF5E) are wide variants of ASCII letters, digits and punctuation, originally for East-Asian typography — now an aesthetic style.
Almost everywhere Unicode is supported (Instagram, TikTok, Discord, YouTube). Some fonts render full-width digits oddly, but letters are reliable.

faqs.q: Does it change the meaning for search?
faqs.a: Yes — "ＨＥＬＬＯ" is different characters from "HELLO", so search engines and in-app search treat them differently. Use it for style, not keywords.
